amendments.normalized_body: Add invariant enforcement for `denitrifier_activity_index` in `invariants.rs:enforce_invariants`. All other 0–1 indices (`biofilter_maturity_index`, `maturity_index`, `nuisance_index`, etc.) are clamped in `enforce_invariants` (lines 21–49), but `denitrifier_activity_index` is not. A corrupted save or deserialization of an out-of-range value (e.g., > 1.0) would propagate unchecked into the denitrification rate calculation at `nitrogen_cycle.rs:537`, amplifying the denitrification rate beyond the intended ceiling.

Add `check_non_negative` invariant validation for `cumulative_n2_export_mg_n` in `invariants.rs:validate_invariants_inner`. This field is a monotonically increasing cumulative counter (only incremented at `nitrogen_cycle.rs:570`) and is part of the nitrogen budget array (`budget.rs`). A negative value from a corrupted save would silently unbalance the nitrogen budget without any diagnostic error.

Add `check_non_negative` invariant validation for the five new denitrification process params (`denitrification_vmax_mg_n_per_l_per_hour`, `denitrification_k_no3_mg_n_per_l`, `denitrification_k_doc_mg_c_per_l`, `denitrification_pore_water_mixing_factor`, `denitrification_activity_maturation_days`) in the process params validation block at `invariants.rs:220–288`. The code applies `.max(0.01)` and `safe_rate()` defensively at the call site (`nitrogen_cycle.rs:531–538`), but all other kinetic process params (aob_vmax, nob_vmax, decomposer_vmax, etc.) are validated up front in invariants. Missing this creates an inconsistency where invalid configs are silently clamped rather than rejected.

Update the stale doc comment on `DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N` in `process.rs:25–27` which still reads 'Reserved for E4b (denitrification implementation). When wiring, add...' — denitrification is now implemented and this constant is actively used at `nitrogen_cycle.rs:572`. The comment should reflect current usage rather than future intent.

Move the implementation into the repository that is actually under review. From `/home/master/p/tank-simulation`, `git diff` only changes `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7:1`; the real code edits live only inside the nested worktree repo (for example `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:15-23` and `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:10-27`). As submitted from the root repo, none of the `tank_core` implementation or tests would ship.

Implement the requested chloride-aware nitrite hazard in the shrimp stress path. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:18-43` still computes `hourly_nitrite_stress_accum` solely from `nitrite_mg_l`, with no chloride modifier and no species-level `chloride_protection_factor`. The modified files instead add alkalinity bookkeeping and tracing (`crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:10-27,337-338`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:15-23,366-385`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/water_change.rs:131-152`, `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239`). Equal nitrite therefore still implies equal hazard regardless of chloride, and the bead’s chloride/salt-treatment acceptance criteria remain unimplemented.
